activeEvents.headline: Siemens Energy reports €15B data-center power orders and raises FY2027 margin outlook to 14–16%, confirming AI electricity infrastructure demand
activeEvents.whyItMatters: Siemens Energy disclosed roughly €15 billion in data-center-related turbine and grid orders, 9.1% of its record €164 billion backlog, and expects its profit margin to increase to 14–16% in FY2027 from 12.4% in FY2026. This is independently reported order-book evidence of AI data-center electricity infrastructure demand and the power-supply bottleneck relevant to AI compute deployment. It is not evidence that GPU orders increased by the same amount.
